hero.title: Build one app that speaks more than one language
hero.description: This example shows how to plug i18next into your existing Vite app without adding any new packages.

sections.routeDescription: Each route can pull the same translation keys, so the whole app stays consistent.
sections.languageDescription: The selected locale is remembered automatically through the browser detector.
sections.fileDescription: Keep i18n setup in one place, then consume it from any route or component.
